input.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
input.rationale: § 14.10 restricts only Customer: we need IBM's consent to assign (with a narrow successor carve-out limited to merger, consolidation or acquisition, and no affiliate or asset-sale carve-out), while IBM's own right to assign is entirely unrestricted, with no consent requirement and no bar on assignment to a competitor of ours. That fails the fallback, which requires mutuality — a mutual right to assign to successors and a reasonable-consent standard for other assignments. The redline adds the affiliate/asset-sale carve-out for us and subjects IBM's assignment to our consent (not unreasonably withheld) with a competitor bar, reaching the preferred position with a single-sentence change. Positively, there is no change-of-control provision anywhere in the Agreement and no IBM termination or re-pricing right on our change of control, so no walk-away issue arises; IBM's subcontracting right in § 14.8 is left untouched.

proposal.summary: Add affiliate/asset-sale carve-out for Customer and make IBM's assignment subject to our consent, with no assignment to our competitors.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We expanded the carve-out so we may assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent, and made IBM's assignment subject to our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a competitor of ours. Our playbook requires this symmetry; as a fallback we can accept a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld.

ops.oldText: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
ops.newText: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement without consent to an affiliate or to a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. IBM will not assign this Agreement without Customer's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Customer.
